# Jobby

Jobby lets AI search and answer engines read, index and cite its public pages with a link
back, and does not authorize any other automated reuse.

Allowed, on public pages that need no sign-in:
- Search crawlers that surface the site in their results: OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot.
- Fetches a person asks for in the moment: ChatGPT-User.

Not allowed anywhere in the product:
- Model training, model evaluation, dataset creation, synthetic data generation, bulk
  extraction and any other collection that is not a search index (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot,
  Google-Extended and similar crawlers).
- Redistribution of the content without prior written permission.

Not allowed for any automated agent, search crawlers included:
- Authentication pages, dashboard and onboarding routes, API routes and internal endpoints.
- User profiles, CVs, uploaded documents, job reports, match scores, ATS reports, interview
  kits, billing data, and any authenticated user content.

Contact: developjobby@gmail.com
